name: Shackle
summary: A gym locker padlock with a real turning dial: dial in three numbers and the locker swings open
about: A close-up of a steel gym locker with an orange combination padlock hanging on the hasp. Drag the dial round, use the arrow keys, or type the three numbers and the dial spins to each one: right, then left, then right, like a real lock. The right combination makes the shackle spring up and turn, the lock drops away and the door swings open on a packed gym bag; a wrong one just rattles.
how: Drag the dial, scroll on it, or focus it and use the arrow keys; press Set this number (or Enter) to keep the number under the pointer
Or type or paste the three 2-digit numbers; backspace and the arrow keys move between the boxes
The demo combination 18 · 04 · 27 is on the tape on the door
With all three set the shackle is pulled; press Lock it again to start over
